description: Find out whether messages arrive and agents can work. Check replies, permissions and runner health with bounded probes. Start with ping; use doctor for a health summary and sandbox for observed restrictions.
author: Serg Parf

selftest.help: Check replies and this agent's ability to store a value and take a lock. Each step reports success or failure; only one selftest runs at a time.

doctor.help: Find disk, service, TLS, connectivity and version problems. Start with the short verdicts; full or disks includes bounded raw output.

args.name: mode
args.help: full: all raw replies; disks: only raw disk facts; omit for short verdicts

echo.help: Inspect the fields delivered with your message as JSON. Process credentials are never included.

roles.help: See the roles delivered with your call. Use agent-bus may-send <name> to check your own permission.

ping.help: Check that the agent answers. The reply includes receive and answer times as Unix timestamps, plus its version.

hello.help: Check a simple text reply by greeting a name.

env.help: Inspect environment names with private values masked. AGENT_BUS_TOKEN is always masked.

sleep.help: Check a delayed reply. Wait no longer than the message deadline; the reply reports seconds slept.

fail.help: Check how a deliberate error is reported. Return error: debug failure <code> and write a fixed diagnostic to standard error.

crash.help: Check recovery after a deliberately killed agent. Terminate debug with SIGKILL and no core dump; the runner restarts it, and this call cannot answer.

sandbox.help: Inspect the agent's user and group IDs, restrictions, limits and path writability. This call makes no host or network probes.

big.help: Check large replies. Return exactly KB times 1024 ASCII bytes.

unicode.help: Check text escaping. Return fixed Cyrillic letters, emoji, newlines, tabs and control bytes.
